# fjordrun_team_secret (Resource)

A team secret, available to agents and workflows. Needs the admin role.

~> The API never returns the value, so it is kept in Terraform state: use an encrypted remote state backend. The value itself can't be compared with what the API holds, but a change made outside Terraform moves `updated_at`, which this resource treats as drift: the next apply writes the configured value again.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "team_id" {
  type = string
}

variable "openai_api_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

resource "fjordrun_team_secret" "openai" {
  team_id = var.team_id
  name    = "OPENAI_API_KEY"
  value   = var.openai_api_key
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Secret name, in the form of an environment variable (`A_NAME`). Changing it replaces the secret.
- `team_id` (String) Team ID.
- `value` (String, Sensitive) The secret value (up to 65536 characters).

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation time.
- `id` (String) Secret ID.
- `updated_at` (String) When the value last changed.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# team_id/secret_id or team_id/NAME. The value can't be read back: the next apply writes the configured one.
terraform import fjordrun_team_secret.openai 11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111/OPENAI_API_KEY
```
